title: UMCP Kernel Specification Repair Audit

tier_0: Specification-repair audit of rc1 → rc2 under six constraints (no silent Tier-1 change; no silent reconciliation of source disagreement; v2.3.3 reproducible; diagnostics below kernel authority; return/seam/regime/stance distinct; compression only when the burden remains reconstructible); holds the 47-item lineage crosswalk moved out of the active specification.

source_role: Repair/lineage audit for the kernel spec; audit witness, not canon admission (handoff manifest; source stance burden).
scope: Audit receipt for the local UMCP kernel specification repair: what changed in rc2, what remained invariant, and what remains open.
non_goal: Not Tier-1 admission, repository certification, or canon freeze; the evaluated object is the local specification, not Summa Reditus or the corpus as a whole.

missingness.notes: Adoption or freeze requires a separate authority act after the open seams close; none is supplied.
